Your own overlay PNGs go in this folder. Make each one the screen's size (1024x768 on the RG DS Plus), transparent where the picture shows.

top.png is drawn on the top screen and bottom.png on the bottom screen, for every game. <CODE>-top.png and <CODE>-bottom.png are for one game.
To use them, set Display > Overlays in the pause menu to Custom (in /overlays). Which Screen there picks the screens: Both, Top Only or Bottom Only. Swapping screens doesn't move them.
A screen with no file of its own gets GBA DS's generated bezel in its default colors.

Names for one scaling or screen shape, and more, in the wiki:
https://github.com/kyannon/gba-ds/wiki/Overlays
